description:
Kangaroo is a SQL client and admin tool.

Kangaroo is a AI-powered SQL client and admin tool for SQLServer databases, support table design, query, model, sync, export/import etc, focus on comfortable, fun and developer friendly.
New features & bug-fixes
- Refactor cloud database menus
- Add more cloud databases support(MariaDB/MySQL/MongoDB/Oracle/PostgreSQL/Redis/SQLServer)
- Update default background
- Add ADBC with FlightSQL support
- Improve data type with decimal support
- Improve app inhibit support
- Sync: Add exist connections select support
- Sync: Refactor source and target connection page
- Sync: Improve database support(Redis/MongoDB/...)
- Connection dialog add database / schema support
- AI: add MCP registry view
- AI: add MCP/ACP registry dialog
- AI: add MCP tools support
- AI: Improve configuration button and menu support
- AI: update ACP to the latest version(1.1.3)
- Fixed: markdown render issue
- Fixed: libpanel L10N issue
- Fixed: close all page issue
